description: SFLOW explicit (A 210 2): uniform sheet flow of 2.1 cm on a slope of 1e-3, Manning n 0.05, dx 20 m (dt g n^2 |u|/h^(4/3) = 2.8): stays at the normal depth with the friction implicit in the stage.
